decision.reason: evidence sufficient (proxy gate verdict; the open aspects need proposals): The changelog line on its own [ev-45cde2b9254f] is only a title, and both proposals cited nothing else. The linked PR #22485 fills the gap [ev-e82cec7cd72f][ev-9324e45745af]. It says that before this change, webhooks looked only at the `syncSource` revision to decide whether to refresh, so an update to the dry source neither triggered a refresh nor rehydrated. After the change, webhooks check `drySource` to trigger rehydration and `syncSource` to trigger a sync. The change is limited to the webhook handler (util/webhook/webhook.go) [ev-5d5f1905b9dd][ev-b0937951c538], and the cherry-pick to 3.0.0 is confirmed [ev-1f713e404b54]. That is enough to write the assertion: the subject is the webhook refresh logic for Applications using sourceHydrator, the change is new behaviour, exposure is limited to webhook-driven setups that use sourceHydrator, and the consequence is informational (pushes to the dry source now trigger rehydration).
